items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: And he wanted to get an all-star orchestra, so he asked me if I would play as a side man

ctx.x: What year would that have been just about? Do you remember?

I don't know how long Leslie George was in business before I have a time, but, uh, he was a good businessman. We played out of the, there was a big affair at the ballpark and it was packed. And he wanted to get an all-star orchestra, so he asked me if I would play as a side man, but he'd pay me to lead us, lead the money, you know. And he got Fazola. Well, he picked the band. And, I'll be, don't go on if he doesn't get on the mic and he extols us to the people, to the thousands of people. This is Leslie George…
Oh, he, listen, he was smart.
